subject: Biology
title: Morphology of Flowering Plants
summary: Morphology bahari roop ki study hai: root, stem, leaf, inflorescence, flower, fruit aur seed. Kai plants mein har part storage, support, protection ya reproduction ke liye modify hota hai.
Dicots mein aam taur par tap roots aur reticulate venation; monocots mein fibrous roots aur parallel venation.

Flower ek modified shoot hai. Iske parts (calyx, corolla, androecium, gynoecium) ko symmetry, aestivation, ovary position aur placentation se describe karte hain, aur floral formula aur floral diagram mein likhte hain.
Teen families detail mein padhte hain: Fabaceae (pea), Solanaceae (potato) aur Liliaceae (lily).

formulas.name: Root types
formulas.formula: tap root (from radicle — mustard);  fibrous root (wheat);  adventitious (from other parts — grass, Monstera, banyan)

formulas.name: Root modifications
formulas.formula: storage — carrot, turnip (tap), sweet potato (adventitious);  prop roots — banyan;  stilt roots — maize, sugarcane;  pneumatophores — Rhizophora (mangroves)

formulas.name: Stem modifications
formulas.formula: underground storage — potato (tuber), ginger, turmeric (rhizome), Colocasia (corm), onion (bulb);  tendrils — cucumber, grapes;  thorns — Bougainvillea, Citrus;  phylloclade — Opuntia, Euphorbia;  runner — grass;  stolon — mint, jasmine;  offset — Pistia, Eichhornia;  sucker — banana, pineapple, Chrysanthemum
formulas.mistake: Potato stem hai (nodes aur eyes hain), sweet potato root hai — ulta mat likhna.

formulas.name: Leaf modifications
formulas.formula: tendrils — peas;  spines — cacti;  fleshy storage — onion, garlic;  phyllode (flattened petiole) — Australian Acacia;  pitcher — Nepenthes;  bladder — Utricularia

formulas.name: Phyllotaxy
formulas.formula: alternate — China rose, mustard, sunflower;  opposite — Calotropis, guava;  whorled — Alstonia

formulas.name: Inflorescence
formulas.formula: racemose: main axis keeps growing, flowers acropetal (older below);  cymose: main axis ends in a flower, flowers basipetal

formulas.name: Flower symmetry and ovary position
formulas.formula: actinomorphic (radial — mustard, Datura, chilli);  zygomorphic (one plane — pea, gulmohur, Cassia);  hypogynous (superior — mustard, China rose, brinjal);  perigynous (half-inferior — plum, rose, peach);  epigynous (inferior — guava, cucumber, sunflower ray florets)

formulas.name: Aestivation
formulas.formula: valvate (Calotropis);  twisted (China rose, lady's finger, cotton);  imbricate (Cassia, gulmohur);  vexillary/papilionaceous (pea, bean)

formulas.name: Placentation
formulas.formula: marginal (pea);  axile (China rose, tomato, lemon);  parietal (mustard, Argemone);  free central (Dianthus, Primrose);  basal (sunflower, marigold)

formulas.name: Stamen terms
formulas.formula: epipetalous (attached to petals — brinjal);  epiphyllous (attached to perianth — lily);  monoadelphous (China rose), diadelphous (pea), polyadelphous (citrus)

formulas.name: Floral formula symbols
formulas.formula: Br bracteate, ⊕ actinomorphic, % zygomorphic, ⚥ bisexual, K calyx, C corolla, P perianth, A androecium, G gynoecium; G with a line below = superior ovary, line above = inferior

formulas.name: Solanaceae formula
formulas.formula: ⊕ ⚥ K₍₅₎ C₍₅₎ A₅ (epipetalous) G₍₂₎, superior, swollen placenta with axile placentation

formulas.name: Liliaceae formula
formulas.formula: Br ⊕ ⚥ P₍₃₊₃₎ A₃₊₃ G₍₃₎, superior, trilocular, axile

examples.title: Root ya stem?
examples.problem: Ginger zameen ke neeche ugta hai. Root hai ya stem?
examples.solution: Stem (rhizome): isme nodes, internodes, scale leaves aur buds hain. Roots par kabhi nodes ya buds nahi hote.

examples.title: Fruit type
examples.problem: Mango aur coconut ka khaane wala part kaunsa hai?
examples.solution: Dono drupes hain. Mango: fleshy mesocarp. Coconut: endosperm (aur fibrous mesocarp se coir milta hai).

examples.title: Pea ka flower
examples.problem: Pea flower ki corolla describe karo.
examples.solution: Papilionaceous: ek bada standard (vexillum), do side wale wings (alae) aur do jude hue keel petals; vexillary aestivation.

examples.title: Placentation pehchaano
examples.problem: Multilocular ovary mein ovules central axis par — kaunsi placentation, aur ek example?
examples.solution: Axile placentation — China rose, tomato ya lemon.

examples.title: Economic families
examples.problem: Fabaceae, Solanaceae aur Liliaceae se ek-ek food plant batao.
examples.solution: Fabaceae: gram, arhar, soybean (pulses). Solanaceae: potato, tomato, brinjal. Liliaceae: Asparagus (sabzi); aloe aur Colchicum medicinal, tulip aur Gloriosa ornamental.

examples.title: Pneumatophores
examples.problem: Rhizophora jaise mangroves mein pneumatophores kyun hote hain?
examples.solution: Ye paani bhari, oxygen ki kami wali mitti mein ugte hain; pneumatophores mitti se upar ki taraf badh kar respiration ke liye oxygen lete hain.

topics.title: Regions of the root
topics.explain: Tip par root cap apex ko bachaata hai; region of meristematic activity (cells divide hote hain); region of elongation (cells lambe hote hain); region of maturation (root hairs paani aur minerals absorb karte hain).

topics.title: The leaf
topics.explain: Parts: leaf base (legumes mein pulvinus; monocots mein sheath), petiole aur lamina. Venation dicots mein reticulate, monocots mein parallel. Simple leaf ki lamina bina kati; compound leaves pinnate (neem) ya palmate (silk cotton). Leaf ke axil mein bud hota hai par leaflet ke axil mein nahi.

topics.title: Parts of a flower
topics.explain: Calyx (sepals), corolla (petals), androecium (stamens) aur gynoecium (carpels). Calyx aur corolla alag na dikhein to perianth banta hai (lily). Apocarpous carpels free (lotus, rose); syncarpous jude hue (mustard, tomato).

topics.title: Fruit
topics.explain: Fruit fertilisation ke baad bani paki hui ovary hai; bina fertilisation bana fruit parthenocarpic. Fruit wall (pericarp) = epicarp, mesocarp, endocarp.

topics.title: Seed
topics.explain: Dicot seed (bean, gram, pea): seed coat (testa aur tegmen), hilum, micropyle, do cotyledons wala embryo, radicle aur plumule. Monocot seed (maize): endospermic, ek cotyledon (scutellum), aleurone layer (endosperm ki protein-rich bahari layer jo use embryo se alag karti hai), coleoptile aur coleorhiza.

topics.title: Family features
topics.explain: Fabaceae: root nodules wali tap root, pulvinus wale pinnately compound leaves, legume fruit. Solanaceae: aksar baal wale stems, berry ya capsule fruits, kai endospermous seeds. Liliaceae: bulbs, corms ya rhizomes wale monocot herbs; perianth tepals; capsule ya berry fruits.

ratta: Potato = stem tuber;  sweet potato = root.
Pneumatophores — Rhizophora;  stilt — maize;  prop — banyan.
Twisted: China rose, cotton;  vexillary: pea;  valvate: Calotropis.
Marginal pea, axile China rose/tomato, parietal mustard, free central Dianthus, basal sunflower.
Fabaceae: A₍₉₎₊₁ diadelphous;  Solanaceae: epipetalous, swollen placenta;  Liliaceae: P₍₃₊₃₎.
Aleurone layer = protein-rich outer layer of the endosperm in cereals, separating it from the embryo.
